concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Retain concept coarse open fold, thick contrasting mineral bands, chunky broken faces. Simplify photoreal microtexture into integrated angular coarse mineral facets. Use one closed surface mesh with folded full-depth foliation coordinates, physical differential erosion ribs; no colored shells or coplanar tiles. Eight coarse uneven bands, not dozens of BIF laminae. Avoid treating the crosscutting pale veins in supplemental USGS DeathValley photo as foliation.
